changelog: FIX (1 GB Fire Stick auto-shutdown — Step 1): The home screen previously peaked at ~200 MB of RAM, enough to trip Android's kernel-level memory-killer on 1 GB Fire Sticks (AFTSS 2018 / AFTKM Lite). v519 adds an automatic 'memory-trimmed Pro' mode that activates only on those devices: poster bitmaps use RGB_565 instead of ARGB_8888 (-50% memory per bitmap), discovery-hero backdrop prefetch is disabled (saves ~25 MB peak), and the Coil image cache is tightened to 7% of heap. The visual experience is identical at TV viewing distance — just the memory footprint changes. Full-RAM devices (4K Max, 1080p with 2 GB+, Shield, Google TV) get zero behavior change.
DIAGNOSTIC (v518): Crash reports now include the Xtream username so support can look up any customer's history by name.
FIX (v517): Navigation Compose bump for BACK-button crash.
FIX (v516): 4 Movie/Series crashes on weak Fire Sticks.
FIX (v515): 'Switch to Lite Mode' takes effect instantly.
FIX (v514): Permanent ANR fix via Moshi codegen.
NEW: 72-hour free trial for first-time Canada users.
